d:
Anant Singh, the MLA from Mokama, is facing a barrage of troubles from all sides: the JDU has expelled him for campaigning against the party's own candidate, Neeraj Kumar; he is on the verge of losing his assembly seat; and his wife has been directed to vacate their government residence.
He may now be sent back to jail; a hearing is scheduled for October 30—three days from now—in the Supreme Court regarding a petition challenging Anant Singh’s bail in the Dularchand Yadav murder case.
